slides.title: Sending digital invites
slides.subtitle: So every guest actually opens it

slides.title: Send it where they already talk
slides.body: Family chat on WhatsApp, friends by text, older relatives by email. One video, three channels.

slides.title: Add one line of text
slides.body: A short personal message above the video makes it feel like an invitation, not a forward.

slides.title: Call the ones who won't open it
slides.body: For a grandparent who never opens links, a quick call plus the video on your phone works best.

slides.title: Ready to send?
slides.body: Animated invitations you edit in free Canva. Just change the names.
